Two Championships, three handicaps and an inter-schools relay were decided at Battersea Park on the above occasion. The main event was the Club 3 miles Championship for the Griffin Cup in which John Davies surprisingly, but decisively, beat P.
The Club 6 miles Championship for the "Tom Carter Cup" was decided at this meeting and the winner was P. Newell, the holder, who had a fairly comfortable victory.

After one lap of the Common very little had been decided despite the faster than usual start; Pat Newell slightly led a pack of about eight runners, with a few more in close attendance.
Yet again the Arthur Whitehead "dustbin" sent the field on its way and after a ½ mile Pat Newell was 14th with Chanin(S.L.H.) leading from Ibbottson and Norris.
The remainder appeared to have no life whatsoever and were certainly not in the same form as at the Southern a few weeks earlier. Individual positions:- 59, P.

On a hot summer evening, and on a bone hard track Pat Newell the defending champion, and fifteen challengers faced the starter. After only one lap 'Glimpy' Jones and Dereck Crooks were a good twenty yards up on Pat and going as though they were after an international vest!
